items.title: Cencora (COR) Stock Looks Reasonable Following Its 217% Five Year Run
items.summary: Cencora has delivered a powerful run over the past five years, yet its recent share price wobble and shifting business mix now put a simple question in front of investors. Are you paying a fair price for the earnings that underpin this healthcare distributor today? Cencora has returned 217.0% over 5 years, which puts substantial long term gains on the line if its current earnings no longer line up with today’s valuation.
